subject: High Maximum LOD Score (permutation tests) and error message.

messages.author: d18738ddff11a439
messages.subject: High Maximum LOD Score (permutation tests) and error message.
parts:
Hi Karl, 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                       

I'm working with a Biparental wheat mapping population, selfed to the F4 generation and genotyped by the 35k snp axiom array. 

It's currently read in as: 

F2 intercross
No. individuals:    107  
Total markers:      1779 
Percent genotyped:  99.6%
Genotypes (%):      AA:43.6  AB:12.9  BB:43.5  not BB:0.0  not AA:0.0  

I've been using the CIM function to scan for QTLs and have had some success. I was originally using the the permutation results from a single QTL scan (HK) to determine Maximum LOD Scores : 

e.g. operm <- scanone(ps1qtl, n.perm=1000, verbose=FALSE)

To save time on the computation. This was giving me a relativity High Maximum LOD Scores : 

LOD thresholds (1000 permutations)
20% 3.62
5%  4.43   

and showing these error messages, when I plotted the permutations: 

Warning messages:
1: In subset.scanoneperm(x, repl, lodcolumn) :
  restarting interrupted promise evaluation
2: In subset.scanoneperm(x, repl, lodcolumn) :
  restarting interrupted promise evaluation
3: In subset.scanoneperm(x, repl, lodcolumn) :
ect...... to 50.......

I've also tried the permutations within the CIM function: 
e.g. cim.perm<-cim(qtl, pheno.col=5, window=1, n.marcovar=3, method="imp", error.prob=0.0025, n.perm=1000) 

This gave me even higher Maximum LOD Scores: 

LOD thresholds (1000 permutations)
20% 4.93
5%  6.00
And again, the error messages: 
Warning messages:
1: In subset.scanoneperm(x, repl, lodcolumn) :
  restarting interrupted promise evaluation
2: In subset.scanoneperm(x, repl, lodcolumn) :
  restarting interrupted promise evaluation
3: In subset.scanoneperm(x, repl, lodcolumn) :
ect...... to 50.......

I can't find any clear information online about the meaning behind the error message. I know the spread of the phenotype data can cause high maximum LOD scores, my data is normally distributed without any major outliers. Any idea why the maximum LOD score is so high? Is it due to the printed error? As I have not specified the exact cross type (leaving it as F2 intercross), could this be a source of the issue? 

I've attached the two permutation plots. Please let me know if you need any more information. 

Thank you for your time.

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] High Maximum LOD Score (permutation tests) and error message.
parts:
I’ve not seen such warnings before and can’t tell what’s going on. But I don’t think it’s causing inflated thresholds.

I would use the permutation results from cim() as they include uncertainty due to selection of marker covariates.

The thresholds don’t seem inordinately high to me. Depends on genome size, cross type, and analysis method.

karl
